name: estate-orbit-verify
description: ESTATE-ORBIT (2026-09-05): the HDB estate is now visible in orbit too, cut at the flat's ceiling (building-section style) so the dollhouse stays open from above. Boots into orbit (the app default), probes the estate-surround group for a mesh census (own-above/own-roof must be ABSENT, every mesh's raycast must be a no-op), screenshots the default boot framing at 13:00, then again at 20:00 to see the lit estate at night around the dollhouse. Run with SHOT_GPU=1.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: probe-estate-census
steps.eval: (() => { const { scene } = window.__three; let group = null; scene.traverse(o => { if (o.name === 'estate-surround') group = o }); if (!group) { console.log('[probe] orbit estate census', JSON.stringify({ found: false })); return } let meshes = 0, names = []; group.traverse(c => { if (c.isMesh || c.isInstancedMesh) { meshes++; if (c.name) names.push(c.name) } }); console.log('[probe] orbit estate census', JSON.stringify({ found: true, meshes, hasOwnAbove: names.includes('own-above'), hasOwnRoof: names.includes('own-roof'), hasOwnWest: names.some(n => n.startsWith('own-west')), hasGround: names.includes('ground') })) })()

steps.name: probe-raycast-inert
steps.eval: (() => { const { scene, raycaster } = window.__three; let group = null; scene.traverse(o => { if (o.name === 'estate-surround') group = o }); if (!group) { console.log('[probe] orbit raycast-inert', JSON.stringify({ found: false })); return } let total = 0, inert = 0, notInert = []; group.traverse(c => { if (c.isMesh || c.isInstancedMesh) { total++; const intersects = []; c.raycast(raycaster, intersects); if (intersects.length === 0) inert++; else notInert.push(c.name || c.type) } }); console.log('[probe] orbit raycast-inert', JSON.stringify({ total, inert, notInert })) })()
